name: Dwight Henderson
source:
Dwight could be considered [url=/c148291]MC[/url]’s arch enemy. Following the fight between them, Dwight was sent to Texas to live with his grandparents to protect him from gangs and bad influences. His grudge toward MC isn’t one that has waned, and his return from prison has given Dwight all the ammo he needs.
